title: Salesloft vs Zoho CRM: Engagement Workflows and CRM Ownership
description: Salesloft and Zoho CRM serve different roles in a sales stack. Salesloft is evaluated for sales engagement, follow-up coordination, and rep activity; Zoho CRM for customer records and sales-process management. Compare sequence workflows, activity synchronization, ownership of records, reporting, permissions, implementation, and total cost. Current plan limits and pricing are not independently verified; check official vendor terms.

verdict: The practical decision is whether your team needs a sales engagement workspace, a CRM system of record, or both with a well-defined integration. Map record ownership and activity synchronization before choosing. Test representative workflows and verify current capabilities, plan limits, security terms, data export, and renewal conditions directly with each vendor. The available record does not establish a controlled benchmark or a universal winner.

faqs.question: What is the main difference between Salesloft and Zoho CRM?
faqs.answer: Salesloft and Zoho CRM serve different roles in a sales stack. Salesloft is evaluated for sales engagement, follow-up coordination, and rep activity; Zoho CRM for customer records and sales-process management. Compare sequence workflows, activity synchronization, ownership of records, reporting, permissions, implementation, and total cost. Current plan limits and pricing are not independently verified; check official vendor terms.

faqs.question: Can Salesloft replace Zoho CRM?
faqs.answer: Do not assume so. List the specific workflows, records, controls, reports, and integrations you depend on in Zoho CRM; test whether Salesloft meets each requirement before changing systems.

faqs.question: Can a team use Salesloft and Zoho CRM together?
faqs.answer: Potentially, if the team needs both workflows. Define which product owns each data field and process step, how records synchronize, how duplicates are handled, and who maintains the integration.

faqs.question: How should I compare their pricing?
faqs.answer: Use current vendor quotes for the same team size and workload. Include seats, usage limits, add-ons, implementation, integration work, training, administration, support, and renewal terms.

faqs.question: What should I test before choosing?
faqs.answer: Use realistic sample data and the same written acceptance criteria for both products. Record workflow completion, missing capabilities, reporting quality, migration effort, permissions, export options, and the total cost to operate.
